question: Which attraction are available within 20 kilometers on the southeast side of Mission Hills Church Park, San Marcos, CA?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.148078 33.148133)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.148078 33.148133)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND tourism = 'attraction'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;

[3].display_name: Mission Hills Church Park, San Marcos, CA
